💡 perfectPixel | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To clean up and perfect AI-generated pixel art by automatically detecting and correcting distorted grids and pixel alignment.
✨ Key Features: • Automatically detect grid size from pixel style images • Refines AI generated pixel style image to perfectly aligned grids • Easy to integrate into your own workflow • Provides both OpenCV and Lightweight (NumPy only) implementations • Offers a ComfyUI custom node for workflow integration
📖 Summary: Perfect Pixel is a Python tool designed to automatically detect and refine AI-generated pixel art. It corrects distorted grids and ensures perfectly aligned pixels, making messy pixel art clean and usable.
